combination.name: Combination
combination.definition: the authors' original pipeline with the SSIM appearance term in the REINFORCE reward, the only slot the pre-specified combination rule changed; chosen per slot on the 6 held-out patients and tested on 20 CTs of the replication cohort
combination.benchmark_baseline_rule: separately with physics and with SonoSPADE frames, the better of two pipelines on the 20 cohort CTs: the authors' original pipeline or, where it tests lower, the combination
